name: Yang Depth Zero Set and Product Law
statement: $\delta_{\mathrm{CM},k}(C)=0$ exactly for ample classes. On disjoint coordinate sets, $\delta_{\mathrm{CM},k}(C\times D)=\delta_{\mathrm{CM},k}(C)+\delta_{\mathrm{CM},k}(D)$, and adding a constant coordinate preserves the defect.
proof: The first assertion is the ample–Cohen–Macaulay correspondence. Yang complexes of products are joins, so their Stanley–Reisner rings tensor and both dimension and depth add. A constant coordinate cones the complex.
